card.summary: On the Free plan, docs are limited to 1GB of attachments.

free_tier.stated: On the Free plan, docs are limited to 1GB of attachments.

egress.terms: Free; attachments served from Coda's CDN with signed URLs

record.tooling: Coda REST API (docs/tables/rows) can create rows with attachment values by URL; API is size-gated at 125 MB doc size
record.chaining: Per-record unlimited: 1 GB x unlimited personal docs x unlimited free workspaces. Personal (unshared) docs on Free have 'no object or row limits', so the 1 GB/doc is the only ceiling - 1,000 docs = 1 TB in one free account.
record.limits_note: 1 GB per doc total attachments; 10 MB per single attachment; docs over 125 MB lose the API and break cross-doc sync; shared docs on Free limited to 50 objects and 1,000 rows (so the docs must stay unshared to stay unlimited); 35 time-based automations/month

identity_cost.detail: Sign-up is by an emailed link or a password.

record.reliability_note: Sharing a doc flips it into the 50-object / 1,000-row regime and can lock it read-only after a 14-day grace period - the unlimited mode is strictly the unshared mode, which also kills public download links.
record.confidence_note: the Free-plan doc-limits page states that no single attachment can be over 10MB

evidence.proved: 'Per-doc file limits (the amount of total attachments in a doc): Free plan: 1 GB per doc'; 'Individual file size limit: Free plan: 10 MB per attachment'
'Personal docs, or docs that aren't shared with anyone, have no object or row limits'; 'Shared docs... up to 50 objects... and up to 1000 table rows per doc'
a Free-plan doc is limited to 1GB of attachments
evidence.quote: On the Free plan, docs are limited to 1GB of attachments.

evidence.proved: a single attachment is capped at 10MB
evidence.quote: Additionally, no single attachment can be over 10MB.

evidence.proved: sign-up is by an emailed link or a password
evidence.quote: We'll email you a link for a password-free sign up. Or sign up with a password.

record.notes: 1 GB of attachments per doc on Free, 10 MB per individual attachment, with no cap on the number of personal docs or their objects
